title: 原因状语从句

examples.en: He didn't come because he was ill.
The match was put off because of the rain.

guess.question: “因为他病了，所以他没来”能说成 Because he was ill, so he didn't come. 吗？

options.text: 不行——because 和 so 不能同时用，只能留一个
options.feedback: 对！跟汉语不一样，英语里“因为”和“所以”只能出现一个。

options.text: 可以，两个一起用才完整
options.feedback: 不对——同时用是典型的中式英语，是错的。

options.text: 两个都不能用，要用别的词
options.feedback: 不对——because 或 so 单独用哪个都对，只是不能同时出现。

rule.rule: because 语气最强，用来回答 why；since / as 表示“既然、由于”，多用于句首；because 后面接句子，because of 后面接名词短语；because 与 so 不能连用
rule.formula: ① because + 句子：He was late because he missed the bus.　② because of + 名词：because of the rain　③ because 与 so 不能同现　④ since / as 多用于句首，表示显而易见的原因

anchors.en: He was late because he missed the bus.
anchors.zh: 他迟到了，因为没赶上公交车。

anchors.en: The sports meeting was put off because of the rain.

trap.wrong: Because it rained, so we stayed at home.
trap.right: Because it rained, we stayed at home. / It rained, so we stayed at home.
trap.why: because 和 so 只能留一个，不能同时使用。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——because 接句子、because of 接名词；because 和 so 只能二选一。

check.stem: ____ he was ill, he didn't go to school yesterday.

options.distractor: so 引导结果，要放在结果那句

check.stem: The match was put off ____ the heavy rain.

options.distractor: 后面是名词短语，要用 because of

check.explanation: 后面是名词 the heavy rain → because of。

options.text: Because he was tired, he went to bed early.
Because he was tired, so he went to bed early.
options.distractor: because 和 so 不能连用

options.text: He was tired, so because he went to bed early.
So he was tired, he went to bed early.
options.distractor: so 不能放在原因句前

check.explanation: because 单独用，主句不再加 so。
